item.title: Rice farming project aims to end food shortage for Ramu Agri workers
item.description: A former section leader at Ramu Agri Industries Ltd (now NBPOL) has resigned to launch a rice farming project after witnessing the struggles workers face in securing enough food each fortnight. Markis Gede, 32, from Ragizaria village in Ward 16, Umi LLG, noted that the demand for food around the Paddox estate is exceptionally high. item.title: Baiyer river cattle ranch poised to unlock PNG’s Livestock Industry in the upper highlands region
item.description: The long-awaited redevelopment of the Baiyer River Cattle Ranch will officially commence on 23rd January 2026, marking a turning point for the livestock industry and promising new economic opportunities for the Upper Highlands region. Livestock Development Corporation (LDC) Managing Director Terry Koim confirmed the start of works during a recent site visit, describing the project as a “strategic investment” that will reshape cattle production across the Highlands. item.title: Govt to repatriate citizens following tragic passing in Australia
item.description: The Marape-Rosso Government has officially intervened to facilitate the repatriation of three Papua New Guinean citizens who tragically passed away in Victoria, Australia, late last year. Foreign Affairs Minister Justin Tkatchenko confirmed today that the State has fulfilled its commitment to the bereaved families, ensuring all consular requirements and funding for the repatriation exercise have been finalized.
